hotelOccupancyNotes: Rough estimate of how full downtown hotels will be, as it bears on each day (within about 10 points). Each day blends 60% of the night before with 40% of that night. Nights are built from the day of the week, the season (November's default; no published figure yet), meetings on the city calendar, the night before ocean-cruise departures (counted per ship), and visitor-heavy nights (Saints weekends, Tulane homecoming, Usher & Chris Brown). The Bayou Classic counts half of the calendar's 50,000, since many fans drive in for the day. The total is the month's average.
